key_insight: Introduce a learned latent-dynamics module that augments pose-driven neural-rendered avatars with a compact temporal state, allowing the same pose to produce different, physically plausible clothing and hair deformations by modelling history/inertia without explicit garment templates.
problem_solved: Pose-only avatar systems cannot predict dynamic elements (loose clothing, hair, soft tissue) that depend on motion history, contact, and inertia; this paper addresses creating realistic, temporally consistent full-body animations from raw multi-view capture without requiring per-garment templates or simulation.
method: Learn a compact latent state that encodes motion history and physical effects (inertia, contacts) from multi-view capture sequences.
Condition a pose-driven neural-rendering avatar on both current pose and the latent state; propagate/update the latent state with a learned dynamics model to produce temporally coherent deformations.
Train end-to-end from captured video/multi-view data using reconstruction and temporal-consistency objectives so the model infers garment-agnostic dynamics directly from data.
impact: Enables higher-fidelity, temporally consistent full-body avatar animation in neural rendering pipelines without manual garment templates or costly physics simulation, simplifying production and improving realism for virtual humans, telepresence, and mixed-reality applications.
visual_elements: Before/after comparison: same input pose rendered by pose-only model vs. pose+latent-dynamics model (highlighting clothing/hair differences).
Block diagram: pose input + latent state → dynamics updater → renderer, showing latent propagation over time.
Sequence strip (timeline): frames with latent states visualized to convey history-dependent changes and temporal consistency.
Quantitative chart: per-frame reconstruction/temporal-consistency metrics comparing baseline and proposed method.
paper_title: Latent Dynamics for Full Body Avatar Animation
paper_authors: Shichong Peng, Chengxiang Yin, Fei Jiang, Zhongshi Jiang, Lingchen Yang
